crossRefs.note: Jesus therefore lifting up his eyes, and seeing that a great multitude was coming to him, said to Philip, “Where are we…
But he said to them, “You give them something to eat.” They said, “We have no more than five loaves and two fish…

translations.web: For his disciples had gone away into the city to buy food.
translations.bsb: (His disciples had gone into the town to buy food.)
translations.kjv: (For his disciples were gone away unto the city to buy meat.)
translations.asv: For his disciples were gone away into the city to buy food.
